summary: This directory is dedicated to the testing logic for assembling and building individual content sections for documentation or readme pipelines. It serves as a verification layer for the structural composition of section items within the pipeline generation workflow.
responsibilities: Verify the correct construction of section items
Test the transformation logic for readme content segments
Validate the output format of build processes for documentation sections
relationships: The build process transforms raw data into section items for pipeline consumption.
Test suites ensure that section items are correctly generated according to pipeline requirements.
designDecisions: Collocation of test files with the logic they verify
Use of unit testing for isolated pipeline components
